snippet.title: The Electorate - Official Trailer
snippet.description:
WISHLIST ON STEAM: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3859180/The_Electorate/

JOIN OUR DISCORD COMMUNITY: https://discord.com/invite/Ne8NsQfvQD

The Electorate releases on October 27, 2026!

Run a complete campaign, from primaries to the general election, across a living political map of the United States. Over 3,000 counties are modeled with real-world demographics, party registrations, and ideological positions, creating endless possibilities. Every rally, speech, and advertisement impacts the number of votes you'll get.

Each campaign features thousands of real-life and randomly generated characters with unique backgrounds, personalities, traits, and attributes. Campaign as any of them, or your own character, to become the next President of the United States or the Governor of Florida. The choice is yours.

Plan your weekly moves and adapt to new conditions. Open field offices, build volunteer networks, buy advertisements, hire staff, and schedule events in any county and state you see fit.
